meta_description:
64 likes, 1 comments - assetyogi on September 8, 2026: "The Hidden Loan Settlement Trap 😳

Most people don't know this hidden risk in loan settlement — if you miss an EMI after signing your bank settlement agreement, the bank can cancel your one time settlement (OTS) and revive your original loan liability with full interest and penalties. What started as a ₹2.1 lakh pending balance can jump to ₹7+ lakh overnight. Before you go for loan settlement in India, always read the default clause carefully, and if you miss an EMI, immediately inform the bank in writing. Understanding the loan settlement process, how OTS works, and its impact on your CIBIL score can save you lakhs. Save this before you regret it later.

(loan settlement, loan settlement India, default clause loan agreement, bank loan settlement process, EMI, CIBIL score, loan settlement letter, personal loan settlement, bank recovery agent)

#loan #assetyogi #personalfinance".
